name: The Painter
source:
An accident born of mysterious circumstances, he has tasked himself with the burden of becoming who he was meant to be. He has clothing, shelter, but no food. 

But he will see to it that his needs are met one way or another.

"I must wear this new self well to satiate an ache in my underbelly."

[From [url=https://bloody-thy-end.itch.io/the-aching-maw]itch.io[/url]]
